items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Then I went back stage after the set and I said: “I meant to talk to you about this”. He didn’t want to hear about it. That was it.
He and Charlie Rouse were the ultimate sharp saxophone players.
Uh-huh, Charlie Rouse. Bird was pretty sharp at the beginning, and Sonny Rollins.
